p3_scope.name: Prepare D: P3 workdir and verify frozen artifacts
p3_scope.content: Create D:\fpga_work\20261020-0209_singleA_aplus_closedloop\P3 (fallback run dir if D: unavailable; record which). Copy frozen bit/CWC/BID/manifest/PC decoder from the new-root paths listed in path_convention.copy_to_p3_workdir; verify SHA256 against the P2 r3 manifest (bit d1ac8726…c142, CWC 37b60854…b25c, BID 3de68e68…f213). Record workdir_used, path mapping and hashes.

p3_scope.name: One SRAM download + reset
p3_scope.content: Use TD BitWriter, AL-LINK-FT, SRAM only. Download exactly once; verify BID 3de68e68…f213 and bit hash; power/reset the board. Do not write Flash. If download fails, stop and keep logs; no second download.

p3_scope.name: UART host + real A frame
p3_scope.content: Auto-detect COM. Frozen bit UART_DIV=1628 at 187.5 MHz = 115.172 kbaud; use 115200 8N1. 921600 is NOT supported by the frozen bit and would require a new bit/CWC (out of scope); record this. Capture one complete real A frame through camera->DDR->A+->compressed store->readback->UART; save raw UART bytes/header/stream/raw/decoded under the P3 workdir; PC zlib decode + inverse; record CRC/length/throughput.

p3_scope.name: TPG boundary handling
p3_scope.content: The frozen P2 bit has no TPG source into the A+ chain; HDMI TPG is display-only. Do NOT fake a TPG A+ frame. Record tpg_a_plus=not_available/boundary. If the user later requires TPG, stop and request a new bit (out of scope). The real A frame is the P3 primary evidence.

p3_scope.name: Record + finalize
p3_scope.content: Record bit/CWC/BID hashes, COM/baud, frame count, header/CRC/length, PC decode/restore, reset/recovery, no half-frame, path migration mapping, workdir_used, and all boundaries. Write P3 result/manifest under the D: P3 workdir (or fallback). No Flash; no second download.
